questions.stem: How do Data Enrichment and Data Cleansing differ?
options: Data Enrichment enhances the data, whereas Data Cleansing corrects the data
Data Enrichment deletes data, whereas Data Cleansing adds data
Data Enrichment is done by IT only, whereas Data Cleansing is done by customers
Data Enrichment applies to unstructured data only, whereas Data Cleansing applies to structured data only
They are the same activity under different names
questions.explanation: The two are often confused, but Data Enrichment is about enhancing the data whereas Data Cleansing is about correcting the data.

options: Removing duplicate rows from a table
Splitting a dataset into training and testing subsets
Converting unstructured data into a structured format
Adding more data to a first-hand dataset from other internal or third-party sources to add context
Compressing data to reduce storage cost
questions.explanation: Data Enrichment adds data from other internal or third-party sources into your first-hand dataset in order to add additional context.

questions.stem: On what must Data Enrichment depend, according to I Am Datapedia!?
options: The preferences of the IT department
questions.explanation: Data Enrichment must depend on business goals; like any other implementation it must follow business requirements, since not every available source is worth storing.

questions.stem: A brand wants to open a new branch. Which kind of third-party data is given as an example of what it could buy?
questions.explanation: The example given is that a brand wanting to open a new branch can buy geographical data from third parties.

questions.stem: A bank wants to offer credit card deals. Which third-party data does the Data Enrichment example say it could buy?
questions.explanation: The example given is that a bank wanting to offer credit card deals can buy credit rating data from third parties.

questions.stem: Which items belong to Demographic Data Enrichment?
options: Marital status, income level, family hierarchy, cars driven and house value
questions.explanation: Demographic Data Enrichment contains information such as marital status, income level, family hierarchy, cars driven and house value.

questions.stem: Which type of Data Enrichment covers buying or spending patterns, interest behaviour and travelling trends?
questions.explanation: Behavioural Data Enrichment contains information like buying and spending patterns, interest behaviour and travelling trends.

questions.stem: Why is Data Integration or Correlation listed as a top challenge in Data Enrichment?
options: Because third-party data is always free
Because there must be some linkage between internal and external datasets, or the data will not match and will not be worth storing
Because external data must be deleted after one year
Because internal data is never accurate
Because enrichment requires a new database engine
questions.explanation: Since the data comes from third parties, there must be a linkage between internal and external datasets; otherwise they will not match and storing the third-party data is not worthwhile.

questions.stem: Which benefit of Data Enrichment comes from being able to purge huge internal datasets with the help of a small, precise external dataset?
questions.explanation: Under Reduce Cost, a small precise external dataset can replace a lot of the internal data traditionally stored for decision making, allowing huge datasets to be purged.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a benefit of Data Enrichment?
options: Eliminating the need for Data Cleansing
questions.explanation: The listed benefits include accuracy, cost, customer relationship, segmentation, targeted marketing, updated communication channels and customer experience; enrichment enhances data but does not remove the need to correct it.
